    • localAxiomKeyOverride

      static final ThreadLocal<Map<String,Formula>> localAxiomKeyOverride
      Thread-local redirect for axiomKey writes. When set (non-null), putAxiom(java.lang.String, com.articulate.sigma.Formula) writes to this map instead of the global axiomKey. Used by session-specific TPTP generation (via TPTPGenerationManager.generateFOFToPath(com.articulate.sigma.KB, java.nio.file.Path)) to avoid overwriting the global map that tracks shared base-KB axiom names.

    • findAffectedFormulas

      public static Set<Formula> findAffectedFormulas(KB kb, Set<String> changedTerms)
      Given the set of terms whose KBcache entries changed (returned by an incremental update method such as addSubclass), identify all formulas in the KB that need to be retranslated to TPTP.

      A formula is affected if any of the following holds:

      1. Direct reference — the formula mentions any changed term in argument positions 0–5 (queried via the KB.formulas index).
      2. Predicate variable — the formula has predicate variables (predVarCache is non-null and non-empty) and at least one changed term is a relation. Such formulas are re-expanded by PredVarInst against the updated predicate set.

      All affected formulas have their varTypeCache cleared so that computeVariableTypes() recomputes fresh type-guards on the next preProcess() call.

      Parameters:
      kb - the knowledge base
      changedTerms - the terms returned by an incremental update
      Returns:
      formulas that require retranslation (never null, may be empty)

    • findAffectedFormulasForSubclass

      public static Set<Formula> findAffectedFormulasForSubclass(KB kb, KBcache sessionCache, String child, String parent)
      Subclass-specific affected formula detection.

      Replaces the generic findAffectedFormulas(com.articulate.sigma.KB, java.util.Set<java.lang.String>) for subclass / immediateSubclass tells. It avoids the "scan every ancestor" explosion that the generic method produces when addSubclass returns ancestors like Entity and Object.

      A formula is affected if any of the following holds:

      1. Direct mention of child — formulas that reference the new (or updated) class by name. Their type guards may be winnowed differently now that child has a new parent.
      2. Signature dependency — formulas that use any relation whose signatures entry mentions parent or any of parent's subclass ancestors. After adding (subclass child parent), winnowTypeList() may now resolve those variable positions to child instead of the broader type.
      3. Predicate variable expansion — only if child is itself a relation in the session cache. Such formulas are re-expanded by PredVarInst against the updated predicate set.

      All affected formulas have their varTypeCache cleared.

      Parameters:
      kb - the shared KB (formulaMap and formulas index)
      sessionCache - the already-updated session KBcache (not kb.kbCache)
      child - arg-1 of the new (subclass child parent) formula
      parent - arg-2 of the new formula
      Returns:
      formulas that require retranslation (never null, may be empty)

    • findAffectedFormulasForInstance

      public static Set<Formula> findAffectedFormulasForInstance(KB kb, KBcache sessionCache, String inst, String className)
      Instance-specific affected formula detection.

      Replaces the generic findAffectedFormulas(com.articulate.sigma.KB, java.util.Set<java.lang.String>) for instance / immediateInstance tells. Adding (instance inst className) does not alter signatures, so no type-guard changes propagate to unrelated formulas.

      A formula is affected if any of the following holds:

      1. Direct mention of inst — formulas that reference the instance by name.
      2. Predicate variable expansion — only if inst is now a relation in the session cache, because PredVarInst enumerates the updated relations set.

      All affected formulas have their varTypeCache cleared.

      Parameters:
      kb - the shared KB (formulaMap and formulas index)
      sessionCache - the already-updated session KBcache (not kb.kbCache)
      inst - arg-1 of the new (instance inst className) formula
      className - arg-2 of the new formula
      Returns:
      formulas that require retranslation (never null, may be empty)

    • retranslateFormulas

      public static Map<Formula,List<String>> retranslateFormulas(KB kb, Set<Formula> formulas, String lang)
      Retranslate a set of formulas using the current kb.kbCache.

      The caller is responsible for swapping kb.kbCache to the desired session-specific cache before calling this method and restoring it afterwards. Each formula's theFofFormulas / theTffFormulas caches are cleared and repopulated as a side-effect.

      The returned map preserves insertion order (LinkedHashMap) so that callers can append the new axiom lines in a deterministic order.

      Parameters:
      kb - the knowledge base (kbCache should already be the session cache)
      formulas - the formulas to retranslate
      lang - "fof" or "tff"
      Returns:
      map from each formula to its list of new TPTP body strings (sort decls and formula axioms); if the formula produces no output the list is empty

      The caller is responsible for swapping kb.kbCache to the desired session-specific cache before calling this method and restoring it afterwards. Each formula's theFofFormulas / theTffFormulas caches are cleared and repopulated as a side-effect.

      The returned map preserves insertion order (LinkedHashMap) so that callers can append the new axiom lines in a deterministic order.

      Parameters:

      Returns:

    • hasUnresolvedPredVar

      public static boolean hasUnresolvedPredVar(Expr expr)
      Returns true if expr contains a Expr.Var in predicate position (i.e., as the head of an Expr.SExpr). Such formulas cannot be expressed in FOF or TFF after pred-var expansion has failed to find any KB instances for the variable's type constraint. They should be skipped rather than emitted as malformed first-order axioms.

      private void collectNumericConstants(List<String> lines)

    • isTptpArithmeticLiteral

      static boolean isTptpArithmeticLiteral(String name)
      Returns true if name is a TPTP arithmetic literal (integer, rational, or real) that is already typed by TFF arithmetic. Such values cannot appear as the symbol in a tff(name,type,symbol:sort) declaration, so callers should skip generating a type signature for them. Covers: integers -?[0-9]+ rationals -?[0-9]+/[0-9]+ reals -?[0-9]+\.[0-9]* or -?[0-9]*\.[0-9]+
